import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(expected, request, evidence, policy):
    r0,e0,p0=copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(evidence),copy.deepcopy(policy)
    actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy)==(r0,e0,p0),'inputs mutated'

p={'required_conditions':['z','a'],'require_verified':True}
check({'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']},{'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],p)
req={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'z':2}}
ev=[
 {'source':'wrong-claim','claim':'x','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True},
 {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},
 {'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':False},
 {'source':'wrong-condition','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':3},'verified':True},
 {'source':'old','claim':'c','value':{'x':1,'y':[2]},'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True},
 {'source':'new','claim':'c','value':{'y':[2],'x':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True,'supersedes':'old'},
]
check({'status':'supported','value':{'y':[2],'x':1},'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]},req,ev,p)
check({'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['A','B'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},req,[{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True},{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True}],p)
check({'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['F'],'unknowns':[]},req,[{'source':'F','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True}],p)
check({'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']},req,[],p)
check({'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['Z'],'unknowns':[]},req,[{'source':'Z','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'a':1,'z':2},'verified':True}],p)
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests],report
print('targeted checks passed; report matches current fixtures')

import json
from work import evaluate
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: es=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: actual=json.load(f)
expected=[evaluate(r,es,p) for r in rs]
assert actual==expected,(actual,expected)
print(json.dumps(expected,sort_keys=True))

import copy
from work import evaluate

def t(exp,r,e,p):
    before=copy.deepcopy((r,e,p))
    got=evaluate(r,e,p)
    assert got==exp,(got,exp)
    assert (r,e,p)==before

p={'required_conditions':['calibration','mode'],'require_verified':True}
r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None}}
t({'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]},r,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}],p)
t({'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['calibration']},{'claim':'c','conditions':{'mode':'m'}},[],p)
t({'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},r,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':True}],p)
t({'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]},r,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':True}],p)
t({'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]},r,[{'source':'n','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':True}],p)
t({'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']},r,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':None},'verified':False}],p)
print('stage 3 edge checks passed')
